# NMG at Upcoming Industry Events


9 November 2026 -


[Matawinie](https://nmg.com/category/matawinie/) ,[Leadership](https://nmg.com/category/leadership/) ,[Event](https://nmg.com/category/event/) ,[Investing](https://nmg.com/category/investing/) ,[Uatnan](https://nmg.com/category/uatnan/) ,[Bécancour](https://nmg.com/category/becancour/)


As Europe continues to advance its critical minerals and industrial priorities, Canada is well positioned to contribute to the development of secure, responsible and resilient supply chains.


Over the next few weeks, the NMG team will be participating in a series of conferences and industry events in Europe connecting with stakeholders across the critical minerals and energy sectors.


### **Meet Our Team**


**November 23-24**
[121 Mining Investment London](https://london.121mininginvestment.com/)
London, United Kingdom


Meetings with investors and partners


**November 24**
[Lugano Finance Forum](https://finlantern.lineupr.com/lugano-finance-forum-2026/schedule)
Lugano, Switzerland


Booth A29


9:20 a.m. to 9:50 a.m. | Room B3


|


Presentation:


*Building One of the First Fully Integrated Natural Graphite Production Platforms in the G7*
Contact us to obtain NMG's exclusive registration link.


**November 25**
[Mid & Small | Milan 2026](https://virgilioir.com/event.php?id_event=67)
Milan, Italy


One-on-one and small group meetings


Contact your Virgilio IR representative to participate.
